description: This file contains security policy checks related to seccomp profiles in Kubernetes, including validation functions and baseline policy enforcement for different Kubernetes versions.

methods.name: CheckSeccompBaseline
methods.description: Returns a Check object for seccomp profile baseline validation across Kubernetes versions.

methods.name: validSeccomp
methods.description: Validates if a seccomp profile type is either localhost or runtime default.

methods.name: validSeccompAnnotationValue
methods.description: Checks if a seccomp annotation value is allowed.

methods.name: seccompProfileBaseline_1_0
methods.description: Checks baseline policy on seccomp alpha annotations for v1.0 to v1.18.

methods.name: seccompProfileBaseline_1_19
methods.description: Checks baseline policy on seccompProfile.type for v1.19+.
